name: Gothic (nestra)
author: nestra, after Peter Ganine's Gothic chess set (1959); prepared by Marc Infield
attribution: "Gothic Chess Set" by nestra on Thingiverse (thing:2821647)
notes: Sculpted after Peter Ganine's Gothic chess set (1959). Freeform pieces: most of every piece is carved by indexed passes rather than turned; hand finishing expected.
changes: rotated so the piece lies along the X axis with its base at X = 0, centred on the axis, the knight turned so its face points +Z, and saved as binary STL in mm (shape and size unchanged); the *_Final files are used; small holes filled.
